_comment: Canonical example for the FEATURE_BRIEF block emitted by the product-brainstormer agent in `feature` mode (an already-onboarded workspace). It is the feature-mode counterpart of the greenfield PROJECT_BRIEF: instead of describing a whole new project, it DIVERGES into a ranked set of distinct feature OPTIONS grounded in the workspace's platform.md, and recommends 1-2 for the product-owner to turn into FR/EC. The brainstormer never writes FR/EC, API design, or UX — that is the product-owner's job; this block is the hand-off. Consumed by the product-owner (reads `recommended` + the chosen option's fields as the seed for requirements). Schema reference and consumer list live in block-schemas.md. Strip the _comment field from real output.
theme: Improve the publisher self-service book pipeline

options.title: Bulk book upload
options.value_prop: Publishers upload a whole catalog in one action instead of one PDF at a time
options.scope: New bulk-upload endpoint + batch UI on the existing upload page; reuses the current single-file storage + status pipeline
unknowns_risks: S3 client saturation on large batches

options.title: Upload status dashboard
options.value_prop: Publishers see live processing status of every submitted book in one place
options.scope: Read-only dashboard bound to existing book status lifecycle; no new write paths
unknowns_risks: Whether status transitions are already event-sourced or must be polled

options.title: Reviewer bulk approval queue
options.value_prop: Reviewers approve or reject batches of pending books from a single queue view
options.scope: New reviewer-facing queue + batch approve/reject actions on existing approval endpoints
